descriptions.normal: A hamburger in which the fowl meat is the main star. The fluffy bread sandwiches slices of fresh vegetables and a flavorful, crispy fowl fillet. No utensils required here: Just grab it in your hands and bite down on that bundle of rich, satisfying succulence with a hearty "ker-runch"!
descriptions.suspicious: A hamburger in which the fowl meat is the main star. The patty has been cut too thin and smeared with too much flour, causing it to taste like bread sandwiching more fried bread.
descriptions.delicious: A hamburger in which the fowl meat is the main star. The fowl fillet has been wrapped in gold and is so tender that you could almost squeeze the meat juices out. The dense flavor of the sauce and refreshing mouthfeel of the vegetables makes you feel like you're walking on clouds as you lose yourself in this feast lying in your palm.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1250 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1900 HP to the selected character.
